blocks.title: Compilers
blocks.text: Compilers woh translators hain jo poore programs ko chalane se pehle high-level languages se machine code mein badalte hain. Un ka maqsad code ko behtar (optimize) kar ke kaarkard machine code mein badalna hai.

items: GCC: C aur C++ ke liye GNU Compiler Collection.

blocks.prompt: Compiler program ko kab badalta hai, aur kya banata hai?
blocks.explanation: Program chalne se pehle, ek saath; yeh kaarkard machine code banata hai jise computer seedhe chala sake.

items: Compilers: poora program chalne se pehle kaarkard machine code mein badalte hain; GCC (C/C++), javac (Java).
